mapper.select: SELECT f.fair_id FROM fairs f WHERE f.canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.fair_id = f.fair_id AND p.status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING_FOR_DEPOSIT') AND p.payment_type IN ('RESERVATION_DEPOSIT', 'VENDOR_FEE') ) ORDER BY f.canceled_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.fair_id, f.name, f.category, f.poster_image_url, f.place_name, f.operation_start_date, f.operation_end_date, f.pet_allowed, f.status, ( f.reservation_start_date IS NOT NULL AND f.reservation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND #{today} >= f.reservation_start_date AND #{today} <= f.reservation_end_date AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fair_dates fd WHERE fd.fair_id = f.fair_id AND ( fd.operation_date > #{today} OR (fd.operation_date = #{today} AND TIME(#{now}) BETWEEN fd.entry_start_time AND fd.entry_end_time) ) AND fd.capacity > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.fair_id = fd.fair_id AND r.visit_date = fd.operation_date AND r.reservation_type = 'ADVANCE' AND r.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') ) ) ) AS reservable, ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recruit_notice rn WHERE rn.fair_id = f.fair_id AND rn.recruit_deadline > #{now}) AND f.status <> 'ENDED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booth_slots bs JOIN halls h ON bs.hall_id = h.hall_id WHERE h.fair_id = f.fair_id AND bs.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_slot aps JOIN application a ON a.application_id = aps.application_id WHERE aps.booth_slot_id = bs.booth_slot_id AND a.status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ) ) ) AS recruiting FROM fairs f WHERE f.published_at IS NOT NULL AND f.canceled_at IS NULL
AND (f.operation_end_date IS NULL OR f.operation_end_date >= #{today}) ORDER BY (f.operation_start_date IS NULL), f.operation_start_date ASC
AND f.operation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND f.operation_end_date < #{today} ORDER BY f.operation_end_date DESC

SELECT f.fair_id, f.name, f.category, f.poster_image_url, f.place_name, f.operation_start_date, f.operation_end_date, f.pet_allowed, f.status, ( f.reservation_start_date IS NOT NULL AND f.reservation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND #{today} >= f.reservation_start_date AND #{today} <= f.reservation_end_date AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fair_dates fd WHERE fd.fair_id = f.fair_id AND ( fd.operation_date > #{today} OR (fd.operation_date = #{today} AND TIME(#{now}) BETWEEN fd.entry_start_time AND fd.entry_end_time) ) AND fd.capacity > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.fair_id = fd.fair_id AND r.visit_date = fd.operation_date AND r.reservation_type = 'ADVANCE' AND r.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') ) ) ) AS reservable, ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recruit_notice rn WHERE rn.fair_id = f.fair_id AND rn.recruit_deadline > #{now}) AND f.status <> 'ENDED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booth_slots bs JOIN halls h ON bs.hall_id = h.hall_id WHERE h.fair_id = f.fair_id AND bs.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_slot aps JOIN application a ON a.application_id = aps.application_id WHERE aps.booth_slot_id = bs.booth_slot_id AND a.status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ) ) ) AS recruiting FROM fairs f WHERE f.canceled_at IS NULL HAVING recruiting = TRUE ORDER BY (f.operation_start_date IS NULL), f.operation_start_date ASC
